events.title: Steam Next Fest Update

events.title: Update log - June 14th
events.summary: It’s been 10 days since the game demo was released. During that time, I’ve made many updates and improvements to the game. Here are the patch notes.0.033 Update【Bug Fixes】Fixed a freeze that could occur when unequipping gear.Fixed a freeze that could occur when being killed by an enemy.
